bio: You’ll find this small restaurant with a pleasant and relaxed ambience in a charming property called Villa San Pietro tucked away along Rua Augusta. Here, the main focus is on fresh fish and seafood cooked on the grill, as if you were dining by the seaside. Colombian Dagoberto Torres, who arrived in São Paulo when he was a youngster, decided to use all his knowledge of maritime ingredients to the benefit of his own eatery. The menu offers options such as oyster and shrimp tostadas, different types of ceviche and grilled dishes that include the catch of the day, pitù, tuna, squid, octopus etc, all prepared with a creative flair and lots of flavour. We recommend pairing these culinary delights with some of the delicious cocktails on offer here....
